screenshot_mode.description: all — screenshot taken after every test.step(). on-failure — screenshot taken only when a step or test fails (Playwright config default). none — no screenshots.

log_level.description: step — console.log at start/end of each test.step(). action — console.log inside every page class method as well. none — no generated logging.

playwright_project_mode.description: new — generate playwright.config.ts as part of the PR. existing — target repo already has a Playwright project; skip config generation and read testDir from the existing config.

playwright_config_path.description: Relative path to playwright.config.ts inside target_repo. Required when playwright_project_mode is existing. Agents read this file to derive testDir and reporter output paths.

input_source.description: ado — fetch story title and test cases from Azure DevOps (default). raw-file — read test scenarios from a local file (markdown, plain text, or JSON); no ADO fetch in Phase 1.

raw_input_file.description: Path to the raw input file containing test scenarios. Required when input_source is raw-file. Supports .md (markdown), .txt (plain text), .json (pre-structured), and a Test Cases workflow output — an .xlsx workbook (excel-exporter) or testcase-generator .json — which is auto-converted to raw-input JSON via the testcase-excel-to-rawinput skill. Path is relative to the workspace root.

user_story_ado_link.description: Full ADO URL for the user story work item. Use this or user_story_id — at least one is required when input_source is ado.

user_story_id.description: Numeric ADO work item ID for the user story (e.g. 1326051). Use instead of user_story_ado_link when you know the ID directly.

test_cases_ado_link.description: Full ADO test plan/suite URL. Use this or the test_plan_id + test_suite_id pair — at least one form is required when input_source is ado.

test_plan_id.description: Numeric ADO test plan ID (e.g. 432931). Use with test_suite_id as an alternative to test_cases_ado_link.

test_suite_id.description: Numeric ADO test suite ID (e.g. 1329228). Use with test_plan_id as an alternative to test_cases_ado_link.

target_local_path.description: OPTIONAL OVERRIDE. The .github folder always lives inside the target project, so the project root is auto-derived as the repository/workspace root that contains .github; generated files are written DIRECTLY there by default (locators/pages/specs and the api layer under the detected testDir / <test_output_path>, and in 'new' mode playwright.config.ts at the project root). The local project is the primary output target; ui/artifacts/ retains a mirror copy only as a working log. This runs in both dry-run and execute modes and is independent of ADO PR creation. Set this only to point at a DIFFERENT directory than the auto-derived project root; leave null to use the auto-derived root.

app_username.description: Application login username. Used when app_auth_strategy is env-var. Preflight writes this to .env. Add workflow-input.current.json to .gitignore.

app_password.description: Application login password. Used when app_auth_strategy is env-var. Preflight writes this to .env. Never commit — add workflow-input.current.json to .gitignore.

ado_pat.description: Azure DevOps Personal Access Token. SECURITY: do NOT store the token value here — keep this null and supply the token via the ADO_PAT environment variable, which preflight reads as a fallback. A non-null value is only for ephemeral local runs and must never be committed (workflow-input.current.json is gitignored). Required (via env var or this field) when input_source is ado or run_mode is execute.

ado_org.description: Azure DevOps organization name (e.g. everi). Required when input_source is ado or run_mode is execute.

ado_project.description: Azure DevOps project name (e.g. Loyalty Kiosk). Required when input_source is ado or run_mode is execute.

api_layer.description: Optional hybrid API + UI generation stage. When omitted, null, or enabled=false, the orchestrator skips build-api-layer.agent.md entirely and produces UI-only artifacts.

enabled.description: Master switch. When false, the entire api_layer object is ignored.

api_source.description: openapi — parse an OpenAPI 3.x / Swagger 2.0 document. postman — parse a Postman v2.1 collection. manual — use the manual_endpoints array. curl — parse one or more raw curl commands (or a plain method+URL+headers API definition) supplied inline via curl_commands or read from curl_source_file (defaults to the run input.txt). Required when enabled is true.

api_base_url.description: Root URL for the API under test. Written to .env as API_BASE_URL by preflight. Required when enabled is true.

api_auth_strategy.description: auto — derive the scheme from the source (Postman auth blocks/pre-request scripts or OpenAPI securitySchemes). none — no auth. bearer-env — API_BEARER_TOKEN. basic-env — API_USERNAME/API_PASSWORD. api-key-header — API_KEY sent via the header/param name found in the source. custom-signature — reproduce an app-specific signer (HMAC/SigV4/packet, etc.) from the source's pre-request script; inputs read via env vars. cookie-from-ui-login — drive Playwright UI login once and reuse storageState. oauth-client-credentials — API_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID/SECRET/TOKEN_URL.

openapi_spec_path.description: Local path or URL to an OpenAPI/Swagger document. Required when api_source is openapi.

postman_collection_path.description: Local path to a Postman v2.1 collection JSON. Required when api_source is postman.

postman_environment_path.description: Optional local path to a Postman environment JSON export. Only used when api_source is postman. Its variables resolve {{var}} placeholders in the collection and seed generated config; secret-looking values are mapped to env-var names only and never written into generated files.

curl_source_file.description: Optional path to a text file (e.g. the run input.txt) containing one or more curl commands or a plain method+URL+headers API definition. Only used when api_source is curl. When api_source is curl and both curl_commands and curl_source_file are empty/null, the parser falls back to the run-level raw_input_file (input.txt).

curl_commands.description: Optional inline list of raw curl command strings (each may span multiple lines with backslash continuations). Only used when api_source is curl. Takes precedence over curl_source_file when non-empty. Secret-looking header values (Authorization, api-key, token, etc.) are mapped to env-var names only and never written into generated files.

manual_endpoints.description: Explicit endpoint definitions. Required (non-empty) when api_source is manual.

domains.description: Optional allowlist of domain names to generate clients for. Empty array means generate all discovered domains.

schema_validation.description: strict — Zod .parse() throws on response mismatch. warn — .safeParse() and console.warn. off — no runtime validation.

emit_hybrid_spec_stubs.description: When true, generate one <story>.hybrid.spec.ts per UI spec with ARRANGE(api) / ACT(ui) / ASSERT / TEARDOWN(api) regions left for the developer to fill.

self_healing.description: Optional locator self-healing stage. When omitted, null, or enabled=false, the orchestrator skips heal-tests.agent.md. When enabled, runs generated specs, isolates locator-driven failures, and repairs only locators/ files by re-inspecting the live accessibility tree via Playwright MCP before PR creation.

enabled.description: Master switch. When false, the entire self_healing object is ignored and the heal stage is skipped.

heal_task.description: heal-failures — repair broken locators from a test run. validate-version — verify locators against an upgraded app version and preserve per-version selectors (old selector for old version, new selector for new version). audit — read-only health check of all locators (reports ok/broken/skipped, writes nothing).

app_version.description: Semver of the app currently under test (e.g. 2.5.0). Required when heal_task is validate-version. Exposed to tests via APP_VERSION / config.appVersion.

previous_app_version.description: Last known-good semver whose selectors must remain valid (e.g. 2.4.3). Required when heal_task is validate-version. Old selectors are preserved under this version, never overwritten.

heal_mode.description: report-driven — consume an existing Playwright JSON report from a manual/CI run (agent does not execute tests); returns a re-run command. agent-run — the agent executes the suite itself.

results_report_path.description: Path to the Playwright JSON report produced by your run (report-driven mode). Generate with: npx playwright test --reporter=json > test-results/results.json

max_attempts_per_locator.description: Maximum re-inspection attempts per broken locator before reverting to the original value and flagging for manual verification.

max_total_reruns.description: Cap on full/partial suite re-executions across the whole healing loop (agent-run mode only).

heal_shared_locators.description: When true, locators/shared-components.locators.ts may be healed in addition to per-page locator files.

strategy.description: semantic-first — prefer getByRole/getByLabel/getByText/getByPlaceholder before data-testid. testid-first — prefer data-testid, then the semantic order.
